title: ‘vedanā, vedanā’ti
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.
groupSub: The Nearest Cause for the Origination of dukkha

paras.en:
(Mahākoṭṭhika:)
“It is said, ‘Feeling, feeling,’ friend.
In what sense is it called ‘feeling’?”

(Sāriputta:)
“‘It feels, it feels,’ friend; that is why ‘feeling’ is said. What does it feel? It feels pleasure, it feels pain,
it feels neither-pain-nor-pleasure.
‘It feels, it feels,’ friend, that is why ‘feeling’ is said.”
